evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 3.04 → 3.33 Torr from t=2520 to t=3240, outside earlier stable ~3.04-3.07 band
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from commanded flow
Temperature tracking setpoint 750 °C well after initial 760 °C overshoot
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-up/pump-down test with Ar off) to distinguish a seal leak admitting air from partial exhaust blockage or gauge drift.
